name: Acne
description: Acne is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become clogged with oil and dead skin cells, forming blemishes on the skin. It can vary in severity from mild to severe.
ingredients_to_avoid: Comedogenic ingredients (e.g., cocoa butter, mineral oil)

daily_routine.purpose: Remove dirt, oil, and impurities from the skin.
Balance pH levels and provide an extra boost of antioxidants.
Maintain skin hydration without clogging pores.
Protect the skin from UV damage which can exacerbate acne.

lifestyle_tips: Manage stress through exercise or meditation
common_myths: Acne is caused by poor hygiene (in reality, over-cleansing can worsen acne)
Picking or squeezing pimples will help clear them up (this can lead to scarring and infection)
when_to_consult_doctor: If acne persists despite home care, if it causes significant distress, or if there are signs of severe acne such as nodules or cysts.
prevention: Keep the skin clean but avoid over-cleansing

severity_levels.mild: Mild acne includes mostly blackheads and whiteheads, with minimal redness or inflammation.
severity_levels.moderate: Moderate acne involves more significant clogged pores (whiteheads and blackheads) and some inflammatory lesions such as papules and pustules.
severity_levels.severe: Severe acne includes nodules, cysts, and significant scarring.

expert_tips: Patch test new products before full application
Consult a dermatologist for personalized treatment plans
Be consistent with your skincare routine
